prerequisites: all mandatory SP-101 P0 inference routes are executed or closed with measured negative findings
the current-100 multibridge evidence packet exists
the route-ablation and requirements-to-decision matrices exist
the canonical SP-078 owner ledger remains empty
selection_timing: Freeze target states only after SP-101 completion and before any video/comment search.
target_eligibility: uncertainty interval is in the widest predeclared tier
at least two independent route families disagree on direction or ordinal band
route-family ablation changes recommendation or practical band
acceleration/end-to-end evidence is materially missing and the decision remains sensitive
independent physical, The Show-implied and PowerPro-behavior estimates materially disagree
information_gain_factors: number and severity of route disagreements
missing evidence family that comments could plausibly illuminate
not_targeted_rules: Do not target merely because many videos exist.
Do not globally crawl high-confidence route-stable players.
Do not treat absence of relevant videos or disabled comments as evidence of slow speed.
Do not force a target when expected information gain is negligible.
independence_unit: player × referenced season/game/event × video × channel × thread × phrase-template × source-layer, with transient run-scoped same-author clustering

privacy_policy.raw_identifier_retention: discard after QA unless platform policy and explicit necessity permit a bounded receipt

governance.zero_target_allowed: only as a measured negative finding after SP-101
governance.zero_usable_evidence_allowed: only with explicit searched denominators and failure/missingness states
